description: Generate a gap-filled daily time series of sensor readings. For each sensor_id, produce one row per day between '2025-01-01' and '2025-03-31' inclusive. Days with no readings should be filled with the last known value (LOCF - Last Observation Carried Forward). Days before the sensor's first reading should have NULL values. Output columns: sensor_id (STRING), reading_date (DATE), temperature (FLOAT64), is_interpolated (BOOL).

temperature.description: Temperature in Celsius. NULL if sensor malfunction.

edge_cases: Multiple readings per day (use last reading of the day)
NULL temperature readings (sensor malfunction - carry forward the previous non-NULL value)
Timezone boundary: reading at 2025-01-05T23:59:00 UTC is Jan 5, not Jan 6
common_failure_modes: FM2: Date boundary off-by-one with TIMESTAMP to DATE conversion
FM4: Using LAST_VALUE without proper IGNORE NULLS in BigQuery
